bagPolicy.summary: Bags or backpacks larger than 14 inches in any dimension are prohibited. Every bag is subject to search.
allowed: Bag no larger than 14 inches in any dimension
prohibited: Bags and backpacks larger than 14 inches in any dimension
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Lots A, B and C provide about 320 off-street spaces, though Lawn-show parking can be very limited. Lot rates and openings vary by show; accessible parking is in Lot A, or Lot B for Lawn shows.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue recommends rideshare services for getting to shows, particularly Lawn events, but does not designate a pickup or drop-off curb on its parking page.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Bars serve alcoholic and nonalcoholic drinks in each room. Food trucks usually attend Lawn shows. Outside food and drinks are prohibited. Concessions are cashless.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Concert viewing areas are accessible, with limited seating for disabled and pregnant guests in designated viewing areas. Email the box office about seating before the show.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is prohibited unless an individual event states otherwise.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will call is not offered except for certain fan-club tickets. If you need ticket help, bring your ID and payment method to the box office on show day.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Door times vary by show. Check the venue event listing. On Ticketmaster, the listed event time is the door time. Overnight lines and camping are prohibited. Lines generally form no earlier than two hours before doors.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
